acceptance: A fixture of run 39389719309 yields only the sizeratchet failure rows (sizeratchet TestRatchet_ModuleFunctionsFitTheirAllowances and the cmd/evolve ratchet test that runs the same check) plus the CI required step row; no fixture text row
Run 39381369373 yields the step row make apicover-check
Text inside the output of another test never becomes a failure row
New and changed functions at 100% coverage
fix: Read the failures of a run from the go test -json stream that each test job uploads (test-integration.json in the coverage-* artifacts): a row is a failed top-level test of a failed package, or a failed package with no failed test. Keep the --log-failed text only for the job names and for non-test failures, named by the failing make target or step. Fall back to the text parser when a run has no test JSON or is a rerun attempt. Pin the four real runs as trimmed testdata fixtures; RED first on run 39389719309. Update the internal/ciwatch package note.
summary: On CI runs 39381369373, 39385027012, 39386265940 and 39389719309 (PRs #1017, #1020, #1022, #1030) `evolve ci classify` listed acs/cycle1946 TestC1946_001_CoreStatementCoverageIsFull, TestRatchet_NoNewRawGitFixtures, TestInnerRunCycleErrorF4, TestPersonaStopCriterionDedupe_CombinedLineCountReduced and a package p / test TestF. All of them are fixture text that passing tests print (for example go/internal/core/floor_blocker_notes_test.go:172). The real failures were make apicover-check (#1017), repocontract TestPackages_HoldEveryTestThatReadsTheWholeTree (#1020) and sizeratchet TestRatchet_ModuleFunctionsFitTheirAllowances (#1022, #1030); the classifier missed all of them. The parser reads the --log-failed text, and go test -json interleaves the output of all packages, so the text cannot tell a printed line from a result line.
title: evolve ci classify lists fixture text that passing tests print as CI failures and misses the real failures

consumed.resolution: branch fix/ci-classify-printed-output: ci classify reads failures from the go test -json artifact (failed top-level tests of failed packages), names non-test failures by make target or step, and falls back to the log text only without test JSON or on a rerun attempt; four real runs pinned under go/internal/ciwatch/testdata/cirun
